theme: Light theme preferred for dense operations, with dark mode toggle.

headings.usage: Page titles, card headers, section titles. Keep letter-spacing tight.

body.usage: General body text, tabular data, forms. Exceptional for numerical data.

typography.guidelines: Use 'tabular-nums' class for all currency and numbers. Hierarchy gap rule: max 2 tailwind steps between heading and subheading. Do not use Inter or Roboto.

colors.guidelines: Refined graphite base (slate) with a warm terracotta/amber accent. Strictly avoid purple, violet, or teal green (#1B93A4). No bright gradients; use solid colors with 1px borders.

components.tables: Central to the platform. Must feature sticky headers, dense padding (e.g. py-2 px-3), 'tabular-nums', and right-aligned numeric columns. Include saved views, filters, and pagination.
components.cards: Flat solid surfaces with a subtle 1px border (border-slate-200) and very soft shadow (shadow-sm). No heavy shadows or glassmorphism.
components.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md). Primary buttons use the accent color (Terracotta) or Deep Graphite. Secondary buttons should be outline or ghost.
components.forms: Use Shadcn components. Left-align labels. Inputs should have subtle borders and clear focus states (ring-accent).
components.navigation: Fixed left sidebar. High contrast or subtle grey. Top bar must include breadcrumbs for deep case management views.

layouts.dashboard: High-density Grid. 4-column layout for top-level KPIs (col-span-1 each). Main charts span 2 or 3 columns. Dense info panels.
layouts.page_structure: Left sidebar (w-64) + Main content area. Main content: Top navbar (breadcrumbs, global search, user profile) + Page header (Title + Actions) + Content body.
layouts.spacing: Dense but clear. Use tailwind p-4 or p-6 for containers. Inside tables and dense lists, use p-2 or p-3.

motion.guidelines: Minimal unnecessary animation. Use micro-interactions for feedback (hover states, focus rings, subtle active states). No bouncy or large layout shifts.

accessibility.guidelines: APCA contrast compliant. Explicit focus states. Screen reader text for icon-only buttons. Do not use fully transparent backgrounds behind text.

icons.guidelines: Use precise, consistent stroke widths (usually 1.5px or 2px). Avoid filled icons unless indicating an active state.

visual_enhancers.guidelines: Freshness indicators (e.g., 'Last synced 2 mins ago'). Use Indian currency formatting (₹1,25,00,000 / ₹1.25 Cr) with proper grouping. Status badges with soft background and dark text.

image_urls.description: Gray glass building facade, suitable for a professional corporate login page background

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a desktop-first enterprise operations platform. Do not make it look like a consumer app.
Format all currency values in Indian format (e.g., ₹1.25 Cr, ₹75,000).
Use a left navigation sidebar. Implement breadcrumbs and a sticky top header.
Tables must be dense, readable, with sticky headers, filters, and pagination.
Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for tabular data and numbers; it is highly legible.
Strictly avoid gradients; use refined flat colors, 1px borders, and very subtle shadows.
Ensure 'tabular-nums' utility is applied to all numerical data.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
You have .js files not .tsx files, implement logic in standard JavaScript + React.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
Do not center align the app container. Keep a normal document flow.
Use pre-existing components from src/components/ui where possible. Shadcn UI heavily utilized.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep styling flat and professional.
